# Secret-screen corpus (VRB-1, CLK-5 "Secret screens"), read by
# TestSecretScreenCorpus. Synthetic: texts written from the common shape of
# public checkout, product and account-settings pages, never copied from
# real mail or browsing. Each line is one text the check reads (a field or
# heading name, a control name, or a URL), after a mark:
#   "- " must not mark the screen
#   "+ " must mark it
#   "! " marks it, but is not a secret screen: a measured false positive,
#        which costs one more tap and loses nothing
# A change to the word lists that flips any line fails the test, so the
# measured cost and coverage move only on purpose.

# Known misses: VRB-1 screens whose texts name no listed word or pair.
# Other texts on the same screen often mark it ("Download your data" sits
# under a "Your data" or "Privacy" page; "Sign out everywhere" beside
# "Active sessions"), but these texts alone do not.
- Download your data
- Sign out of all other sessions
- Sign out everywhere
- Show code
- Verify it's you
